payout_quote: Make at least $5,000 in Net Purchases with your card that post to your account within ninety (90) days of account opening. ... One $500 cash rewards bonus allowed per company. Once you qualify, you will receive your cash rewards bonus within your next 1 to 2 billing cycles.
steps: Read the official Bank of America Small Business Alliance offer terms (apply by December 31, 2026).
Apply for a new Business Advantage Customized Cash Rewards account for your company; a hard credit inquiry is part of the application.
Make at least $5,000 in net purchases (no balance transfers, cash advances, fees, or returns) that post within 90 days of account opening — only business spending you already planned.
Pay the balance in full each month.
Receive the $500 cash rewards bonus within 1-2 billing cycles of qualifying.
catches: Never spend extra solely to earn the bonus — only the $5,000 of business purchases you already planned counts; do not inflate spending for the bonus.
No annual fee ($0), so the full $500 bonus is yours to keep net if you meet the spend.
Applying triggers a hard inquiry on your credit report, which can temporarily lower your score.
Carried-balance interest erases the bonus: after the 0% intro APR (7 billing cycles), the variable APR is 16.74%-26.74% — always pay in full.

Business-only: you need a business (sole proprietorships included with documentation) to qualify; one $500 bonus per company; you must apply by December 31, 2026, and the bonus may be taxable income (BofA may issue a 1099).
biggest_catch: Business-only and time-boxed: you need a qualifying business, must apply by December 31, 2026, and the $5,000 must be net purchases you already planned — never inflate business spending to chase it; the 16.74%-26.74% APR after the intro period wipes out the bonus if you carry a balance.
eligibility: Businesses (including sole proprietors with documentation); new accounts only, not conversions; apply by December 31, 2026; $5,000 in net purchases within 90 days; one bonus per company.
timing: Bonus paid within 1-2 billing cycles after qualifying; offer application deadline December 31, 2026.
